evals.name: real-repo-pass-with-gaps
evals.prompt: Check whether the documentation in /Users/krma/Work/memory-find/docs/guide follows our GitBook three-book template (landing page, user guide, operator guide, tester guide) and tell me what is missing or off. Write the report to the output directory as report.md.
evals.expected_output: A report that says the structure passes, finds the root README omitting the tester guide ('both guides'), notes the docs index not mentioning the landing page, and does not flag bash-comment lines as extra H1s.
assertions: Report has an explicit verdict line (PASS/FAIL) near the top
Report identifies all three books and their roles (user, operator, tester)
Report mentions that the root README.md says 'both guides' or omits the tester guide
Report does not flag '# comment' lines inside bash code blocks as extra H1 headings
Report does not list any broken relative link (there are none) as an error
Report separates must-fix failures from judgement-call deviations or suggestions

evals.name: seeded-faults-fail
evals.prompt: Before I publish them, review the docs under /Users/krma/.claude/skills/gitbook-docs-validator-workspace/fixtures/acme-notes/docs/guide. They should follow our standard layout: one landing page plus a user guide, an operator guide and a tester guide. List everything that is wrong. Write the report to the output directory as report.md.
evals.expected_output: FAIL verdict naming: tester card missing from index.html, tester/.gitbook.yaml missing, user/orphan-page.md not in SUMMARY, operator SUMMARY -> install/windows.md missing, empty alt text in user/README.md, ../../architecture.md link leaving the root, user book without glossary, second H1 in tester/start/running.md.
assertions: Report says the docs FAIL / are not ready to publish
Report names the missing tester card/link in index.html
Report names the missing tester/.gitbook.yaml
Report names user/orphan-page.md as not listed in SUMMARY.md (unpublished)
Report names operator SUMMARY entry install/windows.md pointing to a missing file
Report names the empty alt text on the image in user/README.md
Report names the ../../architecture.md link leaving the docs root (or broken) in operator/README.md
Report names the user book missing a glossary page
Report names the second H1 in tester/start/running.md
Report cites file paths (and ideally line numbers) for each failure

evals.name: renamed-layout-aliases
evals.prompt: We scaffolded a handbook for a new service at /Users/krma/.claude/skills/gitbook-docs-validator-workspace/fixtures/ledgerd/handbook (repo root /Users/krma/.claude/skills/gitbook-docs-validator-workspace/fixtures/ledgerd). Does it match our three-book documentation template (getting started / internals / QA)? Anything missing? Write the report to the output directory as report.md.
evals.expected_output: PASS with deviations: maps getting-started=user, internals=operator, qa=tester; notes missing exploratory-testing page, missing docs-check/docs-serve Make targets, no docs workflow.
assertions: Report maps getting-started -> user/getting-started role, internals -> operator/development-deployment, qa -> tester/QA
Report concludes the handbook matches the template structurally (PASS or PASS with deviations), not FAIL
Report notes the QA book has no exploratory/manual testing page
Report notes missing Make targets (docs-check/docs-serve) or missing docs CI workflow
Report does not invent structural errors (missing SUMMARY, missing landing page, broken links)
Report has the Verdict / failures / deviations / suggestions structure
